description: Read-only XRPL DEX account-offer lookup for one account. Returns that account's outstanding offers rather than global order-book depth; use n9t2_xrpl_get_book_offers for global market depth. Use `limit` to bound results and `marker` to continue pagination, `ledger_index` to pin the lookup to a validated ledger, and `strict` when the account identifier must be interpreted exactly as supplied. Use this for the account's own open offers; it does not create, cancel, or modify any XRPL offer and is subject to the configured gateway rate limits.

account.description: XRPL classic account address whose outstanding DEX offers should be listed.
account.title: Account

ledger_index.description: Optional validated ledger index or selector.
ledger_index.title: Ledger Index

limit.description: Optional maximum number of open offers to return.
limit.title: Limit

marker.description: Pagination marker returned by a previous response.
marker.title: Marker

strict.description: Whether the account identifier should be interpreted strictly as supplied.
strict.title: Strict

name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_offers
